FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Technical Oversold Near MA20 Amid Mixed Geopolitical and Hawkish Fed Cues
tldr_points: Price below MA20 with RSI near 32 suggests oversold bounce potential.
Geopolitical tensions in Jordan and Iran support safe-haven yen, limiting upside.
Fed hawkishness from Hammack offers USD support, creating a balanced bias.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY eyes rebound to MA20 as RSI signals oversold relief amid geopolitical tension and Fed hawkishness.
FX.comment: RSI near oversold and price below MA20 suggest a corrective bounce toward the moving average amid mixed fundamentals.
